name: memhop-archive
summary: L4 archive manual: search historical conversation text (keyword / time range / ID list modes), read single entries by ID
trigger: need to look up past conversation text or dig out old messages; archive l4 raw text history conversation search

resources.name: SearchL4
resources.desc: Search L4 raw text; pick one of three q modes: Keyword (substring), Start/End (millisecond time range), IDs (archive ID list); optionally narrow with TopicID (16-char hex) and Type (text|image|video|document|audio|code|other). For media types (image/audio/video) Content holds a path or URI, not binary
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"keyword":{"type":"string","description":"Substring match (mode 1)"},"start":{"type":"integer","description":"Time range start in ms (mode 2)"},"end":{"type":"integer","description":"Time range end in ms (mode 2)"},"ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Archive ID list (mode 3)"},"topic_id":{"type":"string","description":"Limit to topic (16-char hex, optional)"},"type":{"type":"string","description":"Content type filter: text|image|video|document|audio|code|other (optional)"}}}

resources.name: GetArchive
resources.desc: Read one L4 entry by ID; unknown ID returns an error

steps.action: Read one entry precisely by ID
